description: This file is a shell script for testing rename detection functionality in the diff engine of a version control system (likely Git). It sets up various scenarios, applies file operations like renaming, modifying, and deleting files, and verifies the diff outputs to ensure correct rename detection behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, taking a description and a command to execute.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares two diff patch outputs for equivalence.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern exists (or does not exist) in the input.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or data streams for equality.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the testing timer or timestamp to simulate time passing between operations.
